units.source_text: 但即使这样，也还是不可能的事。

en.t: But even so, it was still impossible.

units.source_text: 实在是过于超出常规了。

en.t: It was simply far too far beyond the bounds of what was normal.

units.source_text: 自己有正经的户口，有正当的职业，老老实实地缴纳税金，还持有医疗保险证。

en.t: He had a proper household registration, a legitimate occupation, paid his taxes honestly, and even carried a health insurance card.

units.source_text: 难道允许把这种正正经经的大人，当成老鼠、昆虫似的张网捕捉吗？

en.t: Could it really be permitted to set a net and trap a respectable adult like him as if he were a rat or an insect?

units.source_text: 恐怕有什么误解吧，肯定有误解。

en.t: There must be some misunderstanding, surely there had to be a misunderstanding.

units.source_text: 除了说是误解，没有其他可想的了。

en.t: There was nothing else to think except that it was a misunderstanding.
